cases.id: m1 a run grades every case with its own check and reports the pass rate
cases.says: A run grades each case with its own check (exact, regex), reports the pass rate and the order of the results, and an empty set has rate 0.0

cases.id: e1 an exact check ignores case and spacing but nothing else
cases.says: An exact check ignores case and spacing only: a longer word, a different word and an empty output fail; a regex is a search, and an anchored one still fails on extra text

cases.id: e2 a json field check needs a json object with the field and the same typed value
cases.says: A json field check: a JSON object, the field present, the same typed value; a fenced block, prose around the JSON and an array are not json

cases.id: e3 a judge check sends the rubric prompt and accepts only a bare score at the threshold
cases.says: A judge check: the exact prompt, a bare score at the threshold passes, a lower score fails, and a reply that is not a bare score, no judge or a judge that raises is ungradable

cases.id: e4 a model that fails on one case does not stop the run
cases.says: A model error fails its own case with model error and the run goes on

cases.id: e5 tags report their own rates and success criteria judge each dimension
cases.says: Tags report their own pass rates; meets judges the overall rate, each tag (a missing tag fails) and the flaky count, and a rate equal to its minimum passes

cases.id: e6 a regression run names what broke what was fixed and what went missing
cases.says: compare names regressions, fixes, added and removed cases; a better average with a regression is not ok; a removed case is not ok

cases.id: e7 repeated runs expose flaky cases and a case passes only if every run does
cases.says: Repeated runs: a case passes only if every run passes, a mixed case is flaky, a consistently failing case is not flaky, and the model is called once per run
